content:
C works (reports no-bench), so input is being received. But movement doesn't change my tile. This strongly suggests the notice board on my tile blocks movement — I'm stuck on a blocking tile.

Let me try one more idea: maybe I need to interact with the notice board to "read" it and that frees me. Since E targets the front tile, let me face the notice board... but it's on my tile. 

Wait — maybe the notice board is actually at (2,7) but I'm at a fractional position and the "front" tile when facing a direction could be my own tile if I'm offset. Let me try pressing E facing all 4 directions and see if any reads the notice.
